title: I can’t believe this is actually happening and more importantly I can...
transcript: Apparently, there is going to be a Klaine reunion at Darren's concert in London tonight, and I am not doing well about it. The rumor is that they're going to be singing baby, it's Cold Outside. And I may or may not have heard a leaked video from their sound check and immediately burst out into tears. Like, I know that some of you watching do not understand what, what a big deal that is, so, like, let me try and put it into words. Chris Colfer has been basically retired for, like, probably 10 years now, does not perform anymore and has moved on to writing very successful children's novels. So not only is he coming out of retirement for this concert, but Darren and Chris have never sung a duet together live. Like, this is their first ever live duet ever, which is just insane. And then on top of all of this, you have the Glee boot rumours, which the running joke has been, they're gonna have to find some way to explain why Kurt isn't a part of it, because there's absolutely no way that Chris Colfer would want to come back. Like, he has said multiple times that he is done with glee. But now, now I'm like, maybe he would? So this is just, like, blown up everything that we thought we knew about a potential Glee boot and Chris's involvement. And so, like, I am really trying not to get my hopes up, but at The same time, I never thought that we would get them singing together again. Ever. And so it kind of feels like anything's possible?
classificationReason: Content is about a Darren Criss concert in London featuring a surprise duet with Chris Colfer (Glee reunion). Not a stage production from the list.
